_comment: Every API METHOD must be classified. A path matched by PROTECTED_API_PREFIXES in proxy.ts has all of its methods gated and needs no entry. Everything else — including paths in PUBLIC_API_PREFIXES, which gate NOTHING — needs one entry per method, keyed 'METHOD /api/path'.

_classifications.route-self-protected: The proxy does not gate it; the handler authenticates the caller itself. unauth_status must be 401/403.
_classifications.deliberately-public: Reachable anonymously on purpose, and that exposure was chosen. unauth_status is a success code.
_classifications.accepted-exposure-pending-remediation: Anonymously reachable, adjudicated, and judged WRONG — but the fix is scheduled rather than immediate. unauth_status records the current (undesired) status and `remediation` names the change that closes it. This exists so that 'we looked and it should change' is expressible without either lying that it is fine or blocking on it.
_classifications.proxy-protected: Gated by PROTECTED_API_PREFIXES in proxy.ts — every method on the path requires a session. unauth_status must be 401. An entry is not required for these (the proxy classifies them), but one is kept where the decision to gate is itself worth recording.

_provenance.decision: Someone chose this posture for this method and signed for it. decided_by names them.
_provenance.discovery: Records what the code was found doing. NOT a requirement. Fails the control until adjudicated.

_reconciliation_rule: Never resolve a red by writing down what the route currently does. If declared posture and observed posture disagree, the route changes, not the declaration. Where the route cannot change yet, say so with accepted-exposure-pending-remediation — do not relabel it deliberately-public.
_readjudication_2026_08_02: The previous route-level file was re-adjudicated entry by entry, not merely widened to methods. Three entries were found to be DISCOVERIES presented as requirements: /api/zte, /api/swarm-status and /api/curator-proposals were never decided public — they fell through proxy.ts's default-open fallthrough and were documented afterwards as 'deliberately-public', each citing the next as precedent. All three are now adjudicated as exposures that should close, pending the proxy default-deny inversion. GET /api/kill-switch previously carried unauth_status 401 in a single per-route entry while actually answering 200, which no assertion could catch because the unit was a route and the two methods disagreed.

GET /api/kill-switch.reason: Reads swarm state from upstream with a borrowed PI_CEO_PASSWORD. Was unauthenticated and observed live returning 200 to an anonymous caller on 2026-08-02; the prior per-route entry declared 401 because POST refuses, which a route-level unit could not distinguish. Now gated by the same isAuthorised() as POST.

POST /api/kill-switch.reason: kill|resume requires a pi_session cookie or X-Kill-Switch-Secret, constant-time compared, fail-closed. Closed by the #603 hotfix after an anonymous POST could kill or resume the swarm.

POST /api/telegram.reason: Telegram webhook. /api/telegram is in PUBLIC_API_PREFIXES because Telegram must POST without a session, so the proxy gates nothing and the handler must: TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET is required, must be presented, and must match. Chat-ID allowlist fail-closed behind it.

POST /api/auth/login.reason: CORRECTED 2026-08-02. Previously declared unauth_status 401, which was FALSE: auth/login/route.ts:66 returns HTTP 200 with {ok:false} for a wrong password, and 400 for unparseable JSON. The old control only checked that a declared number was >=400, so a false declaration passed green — the exact defect this file exists to catch, reproduced inside the fix for it. Corrected the DECLARATION, not the route: 200-with-{ok:false} is deliberate and issues no cookie on failure, so the route is right and the record was wrong. This is not the forbidden move of writing down current behaviour to silence a red — that rule applies when the ROUTE is the defect; here it was not.
POST /api/auth/login.decided_by: claude-opus-5 session 1312b3c1 — correction of a false record

GET /api/cron/analyze.reason: RA-1504: requires Authorization: Bearer CRON_SECRET. Called by the Vercel cron declared in vercel.json. A genuine prior decision — the credential requirement was specified, not observed after the fact.

POST /api/margot/bubble.reason: Requires TAO_WEBHOOK_SECRET before proxying to Railway; returns 401 without it.

GET /api/phone/gate.reason: Shared handler checks the pi_session cookie before proxying to Railway. GET and POST are the same function (`export const GET = handle`), so the two methods cannot drift apart — the structural property the rest of this surface lacks.

POST /api/phone/progress.reason: Checks the pi_session cookie before proxying to Railway.

POST /api/webhook/github.reason: HMAC-SHA256 signature over the raw body, constant-time compared. Unconfigured secret is 401, not a bypass.

POST /api/webhook/intake.reason: X-Intake-Secret validated against INTAKE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, constant-time over digests. Config-independent 401 so an unauthenticated probe cannot distinguish unset from wrong.

POST /api/webhook/morning-intel.reason: X-Pi-CEO-Secret validated against WEBHOOK_SECRET. RA-6904: an unconfigured deploy answers 503 rather than 401, matching Railway's fail-closed behaviour.

GET /api/zte.reason: GATED 2026-08-02. Reaches upstream with a borrowed PI_CEO_PASSWORD, so an anonymous caller read internal scoring through a credential it did not hold. Previously recorded 'deliberately-public', which was a DISCOVERY presented as a requirement: it fell through proxy.ts's default-open fallthrough and was documented afterwards, citing /api/zte as precedent — and zte cited nothing. Now in PROTECTED_API_PREFIXES. Its only real callers are panels mounted on /control, itself already a protected page, so gating costs nothing.

GET /api/swarm-status.reason: GATED 2026-08-02. Disclosed automation posture — swarm state, autonomous PR count and daily limit — i.e. when automation runs unattended and how much budget remains. Previously recorded 'deliberately-public', which was a DISCOVERY presented as a requirement: it fell through proxy.ts's default-open fallthrough and was documented afterwards, citing /api/zte as precedent — and zte cited nothing. Now in PROTECTED_API_PREFIXES. Its only real callers are panels mounted on /control, itself already a protected page, so gating costs nothing.

Previously recorded 'deliberately-public', which was a DISCOVERY presented as a requirement: it fell through proxy.ts's default-open fallthrough and was documented afterwards, citing /api/zte as precedent — and zte cited nothing. Now in PROTECTED_API_PREFIXES. Its only real callers are panels mounted on /control, itself already a protected page, so gating costs nothing.
